titulo: Me choosing a seat in an empty room
caption:
Me choosing a seat in an empty room

Me choosing a seat in an empty room.

With every seat free, choosing gets harder, not easier. Take the first one that felt right: the fourth look rarely finds a better one.

Send it to the friend who circles the whole room before sitting.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks along a row of three empty stools. It stops at the first stool, eyes wide, tilts, then walks on to the second, tilts the other way, then to the third and looks up. Finally it walks all the way back to the first stool, its eyes turn happy and it pulses, then it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me choosing a seat in an empty room.
